summary: Former Unicoi County fire tower site beside the Appalachian Trail; the state index lists the tower as removed and a 0.36-mile trail detour reaches the site.

facts.status_note: Removed; the sources describe a former lookout site, not a standing tower.

visit.trail_note: Reached by a 0.36-mile (0.58 km) detour off the Appalachian Trail, with about 500 feet (152 m) of climbing.

events.note: Temple Hill Fire Tower is shown on a 1935 map, per the site page's photo caption.

notes_for_editor: Two sources only: the state index and the WillhiteWeb Appalachian Trail site page. The page's search description says Georgia, but its body says State: Tennessee and County: Unicoli (sic); the index says Unicoi and cnf, so the body is used. Elevation 3,697 ft (index, derived from USGS 10 m DEM) vs 3,710 ft (site page), unexplained. The 1935 map is the only dated item; no build date, builder, staffing, fire or register listing was found in the cache. Brief record had no status; facts.status set to gone per the index's removed. Land ownership and public status of the spot are not described by any source, so no access level is set. Trail detour from the site page is the only visit information.
